name: Everything is In Diamonds Dimension !
summary: A mod where there is a diamonds new dimension, and a craft for a flint and steel to get in this dimensions trough a diamonds portal
body: Craft a special lighter using 9 diamond blocks and a flint & steel, then right-click to open a portal leading to the Diamond Dimension. This dimension is made entirely of diamond—blocks, mountains, and even the ground. Explore its sparkling landscapes, and make fun ! To return, simply step back through the portal or made a new one.
